children: lululemon athletica announced results for the second quarter of fiscal 2026, with net revenue of $2.416 billion and diluted EPS of $2.92. Comparable sales declined 9% (10% constant dollars) while gross margin expanded to 60.5% driven in part by $134.5 million of tariff refunds. The company reported income from operations of $453.7 million and reiterated a revised full-year 2026 revenue outlook of $10.35–10.50 billion.
Net revenue: $2,415,631 thousand for Q2 2026 (decrease 4% year-over-year; decrease 5% on a constant dollar basis).
Gross profit: $1,461,878 thousand; gross margin 60.5% (increase of 200 bps year-over-year). Includes $134.5 million of tariff refunds that increased gross margin by 560 bps.
Income from operations: $453,653 thousand; operating margin 18.8% (decrease of 190 bps year-over-year). Tariff refunds increased operating margin by 560 bps.
Net income: $329,223 thousand for the quarter.
Diluted earnings per share: $2.92 for Q2 2026 (includes $0.86 per share related to tariff refunds and associated interest, net of tax).

Regional performance: Americas net revenue decreased 8% and Americas comparable sales decreased 12%; International net revenue increased 4% (2% constant dollars) while international comparable sales decreased 3% (6% constant dollars).
Tariff refunds: The company received IEEPA tariff refunds of $134.5 million plus $4.1 million of associated interest, recorded as a reduction of COGS and other income respectively.
Share repurchases: The company repurchased 2.7 million shares during the quarter for $330.0 million.
Store growth: Opened nine net new company-operated stores in the quarter, ending with 825 stores and total gross square feet of approximately 3,880 thousand.

Liquidity and inventory: Cash and cash equivalents of $1.390 billion and $593.7 million available capacity under the committed revolving credit facility; inventories decreased 1% year-over-year (7% decline on a unit basis).
